title: p2p: reconsider orphans when missing inputs are mined

target.summary: BlockConnected passes m_opts.m_rng to AddChildrenToWorkSet while running on the validation thread without holding g_msgproc_mutex. When an orphan with multiple announcers is reconsidered, this causes a data race with message processing on the non-thread-safe RNG.
notes: faulty call passing non-thread-safe m_opts.m_rng from validation thread without holding g_msgproc_mutex
definition of the method that takes and uses the non-thread-safe RNG parameter
